title: Sunday · the school from the beach road
logline: Small Wood High from the road to the beach, a week after the bell, summer-empty. The bike rack. The steps. Ten years since he walked out of it.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the school from the beach road, low, the brick and the flagpole and the empty bike rack, a June afternoon with nobody.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a small brick high school seen from a quiet road on a June afternoon with an empty bike rack and a flagpole and no people, no words

panels.name: School

panels.composition: Tier 2: the front steps. Three worn places on the third step.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, close on a school's concrete front steps with three worn pale patches on one step, no words

panels.name: Steps

panels.composition: Tier 3: the road to the beach from the steps. The way they all went. Held.
